title: Figure 22: Comparison of Known and Unknown Object Sightings by Shape, 1947–1952
description: Back-to-back horizontal bar chart comparing "Total Less Unknown" (left) and "Unknown" (right) object sightings, in percent, by reported shape: Elliptical, Rocket and aircraft, Meteor or comet, Lenticular conical or teardrop, Flame, Other shapes and Not stated. Both axes run from 0 to 50 percent, and Elliptical is the largest category on both sides. Caption: "FIGURE 22 COMPARISON OF KNOWN AND UNKNOWN OBJECT SIGHTINGS BY SHAPE, 1947-1952"; drawing A-7500.
